question: Does the goal-reaching PPO critic estimate full stochastic-policy returns before and after the observed collapse?
models: Depth unchanged-reward continuation final u480 complete state
cases: Eight fresh train/procedural initial states, each repeated16 times with independently sampled policy actions. Fixed source curriculum progress300/1080, reset RNG fold730020 and action RNG fold730021. Both frozen policies use the same initial states and action random stream. No evaluation cases or learning.
measure: Per state: original critic prediction,16 complete undiscounted returns, mean, standard error, descriptive bootstrap95% interval, success/event counts. Save per-step rewards/actions/events/positions and all identities. Finite-horizon TIMEOUT is terminal, so no residual critic bootstrap is added.
checks: identical initial physical and observation state within each16-replica group
identical initial critic prediction within each group
all128 episodes reach a terminal event
finite raw outcomes and independently recomputed full returns
interpretation: A critic error larger than0.25 reward units is a practically relevant discrepancy for the +/-1 terminal reward. Report uncertainty and all eight states, not a pooled selected example. Bootstrap intervals with16 replicas are exploratory, not simultaneous tests or proof of a unique collapse cause. This is fixed initial-state calibration, not coverage of all visited recurrent histories.
budget: Exactly256 complete frozen-policy episodes, at most768000 allocated simulation slots; record active interactions and wall time separately.
